XMLDB.COMMENT: local_coursepilot: OAuth client registration (#335), authorization codes and tokens (#336), change-history snapshots (#385), retention and deletion period (#387), mark memory (#493)

TABLE.NAME: local_coursepilot_oauth_client
TABLE.COMMENT: OAuth clients registered via DCR (RFC 7591) or CIMD.

FIELD.NAME: clientid
FIELD.COMMENT: Public client_id, issued via DCR or the CIMD URL itself.

FIELD.NAME: redirecturis
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON array of allowed redirect_uris.

FIELD.NAME: clientsecret
FIELD.COMMENT: Set only for client_secret_post.

FIELD.NAME: source
FIELD.COMMENT: dcr or cimd.

TABLE.NAME: local_coursepilot_oauth_code
TABLE.COMMENT: Short-lived authorization codes, PKCE-bound, redeemable exactly once (#336).

FIELD.NAME: codechallenge
FIELD.COMMENT: Client PKCE S256 challenge.

TABLE.NAME: local_coursepilot_oauth_grant
TABLE.COMMENT: Stable user/client connection; shared rotation and revocation state (#638).

INDEX.NAME: revoked_clientid
INDEX.COMMENT: Revoked connection and unused client cleanup (#644).

TABLE.NAME: local_coursepilot_oauth_budget
TABLE.COMMENT: Windowed anonymous OAuth budgets per scope, site and source; rows expire with their window (#642).

FIELD.NAME: scope
FIELD.COMMENT: register or cimd.

FIELD.NAME: sourcekey
FIELD.COMMENT: * for the site counter, otherwise HMAC of the trusted request source.

FIELD.NAME: expires
FIELD.COMMENT: End of the window.

TABLE.NAME: local_coursepilot_oauth_token
TABLE.COMMENT: SHA-256 hashes of access and refresh tokens, 1h/30d, refresh rotation (#336, #534).

FIELD.NAME: connectionid
FIELD.COMMENT: Stable grant; NULL only for historical rows whose family is unknown.

FIELD.NAME: accesstokenhash
FIELD.COMMENT: sha256(access token); the secret itself is never stored.

FIELD.NAME: refreshtokenhash
FIELD.COMMENT: sha256(refresh token); the secret itself is never stored.

FIELD.NAME: expires
FIELD.COMMENT: Access token expiry.

TABLE.NAME: local_coursepilot_cm_version
TABLE.COMMENT: Complete state of a course_modules write (form path, manual change, bulk edit or later API), anchored on the stable cmid (#385, Spec 0015 §10).

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: Course at the time of the write - needed for the course cascade (#387): course_modules is already deleted at the course_deleted event.

FIELD.NAME: version
FIELD.COMMENT: Sequential per cmid, starting at 1.

FIELD.NAME: source
FIELD.COMMENT: Origin of the write: moodle (native write path), discovered (before-state created retroactively at the first observed event, #386) or cloned (clone_activity, #421); later API clients carry their own value.

FIELD.NAME: sourcecmid
FIELD.COMMENT: Source module ID of a clone (#421) - set only for source=cloned, otherwise NULL.

FIELD.NAME: moduleinfo_json
FIELD.COMMENT: get_moduleinfo_data() field object (instance record, tags, availability, gradepass/gradecat/outcomes).

FIELD.NAME: coursemodule_json
FIELD.COMMENT: Complete course_modules row at the time of the write.

FIELD.NAME: arrangement_json
FIELD.COMMENT: Arrangement state (quiz_slots+question_references, quiz_sections, quiz_feedback) - quiz only, otherwise NULL (#396, Spec 0015 section 10).

INDEX.NAME: cmid_timecreated
INDEX.COMMENT: Supports opportunistic retention cleanup per cmid (#387).

INDEX.NAME: timecreated
INDEX.COMMENT: Scheduled retention batches across all activities (#640).

TABLE.NAME: local_coursepilot_cm_file
TABLE.COMMENT: Deduplicated file metadata (no bytes) per pathnamehash+contenthash; one record can be referenced by several versions (#385).

TABLE.NAME: local_coursepilot_cm_version_file
TABLE.COMMENT: Links a version to the module-context files present at that time; gap marks files outside the description as not restorable (#385).

FIELD.NAME: gap
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = file content outside the description, not restorable.

INDEX.NAME: fileid
INDEX.COMMENT: Reference check before deleting orphaned file metadata (#640).

TABLE.NAME: local_coursepilot_context_mark
TABLE.COMMENT: Mark memory (#493, Spec #486 section 6): only the 'marked yes/no' bit per context file, keyed by path, size, modification time and ETag.

FIELD.NAME: path
FIELD.COMMENT: Client path of the file, relative to the context area.

FIELD.NAME: pathhash
FIELD.COMMENT: sha1(path) - backs the unique index so it stays short regardless of path length.

FIELD.NAME: etag
FIELD.COMMENT: NULL if the storage provides no ETags (IServ mode).

FIELD.NAME: ismarked
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = frontmatter carries 'coursepilot.personenbezug: true'.

TABLE.NAME: local_coursepilot_workbench_ticket
TABLE.COMMENT: One-time download ticket for a workbench file (#501, Spec #486 section 13): bound to person, path and contenthash, valid for 15 minutes; only the hash of the ticket itself is stored.

FIELD.NAME: path
FIELD.COMMENT: Client path of the workbench file, relative to the workbench root.

FIELD.NAME: contenthash
FIELD.COMMENT: Checked against the current file content on retrieval - changes since issuance are rejected.

FIELD.NAME: tickethash
FIELD.COMMENT: sha256(ticket secret) - the secret itself is never stored.

FIELD.NAME: oauthconnectionid
FIELD.COMMENT: Stable issuing grant, independent of rotation.

FIELD.NAME: oauthtokenid
FIELD.COMMENT: local_coursepilot_oauth_token.id of the issuing connection, NULL if none was known.
